summary: Verified fix from iteration_26: App.js now uses MainContent component with useLocation() hook rendered inside BrowserRouter. SPA navigation between /trading and Dashboard (/) now immediately (within 300ms) toggles main's className between 'w-full' (full-width Dashboard) and 'container mx-auto p-4 md:p-6' (padded layout), with no raciness across 2 round-trip test cycles.
critical_code_review_comments: MainContent correctly placed inside BrowserRouter and uses useLocation() reactively - resolves the previous non-reactive window.location.pathname read. No other issues found in this narrow scope.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug from iteration_26 (non-reactive layout on SPA nav) is fully fixed and confirmed. No further action needed on this specific issue.
rca_of_the_issue: Previously App computed main's className directly from window.location.pathname in the App component (outside Router context), which doesn't re-render on client-side navigation. Fix moved this logic into a new MainContent component rendered inside BrowserRouter using useLocation() hook, which properly triggers re-render on route changes.
